crossRefs.note: The portion of Jacob is not like these; for he is the maker of all things; and Israel is the tribe of his inheritance…
Yahweh assigned my portion and my cup. You made my lot secure.
My flesh and my heart fails, but God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever.
But our God is in the heavens. He does whatever he pleases.
“Yahweh is my portion,” says my soul. “Therefore I will hope in him.”
“He has made the earth by his power. He has established the world by his wisdom. By his understanding he has stretched…
“I have forsaken my house. I have cast off my heritage. I have given the dearly beloved of my soul into the hand of her…
“Because you are glad, because you rejoice, O you who plunder my heritage, because you are wanton as a heifer that…
Now therefore, if you will indeed obey my voice, and keep my covenant, then you shall be my own possession from among…
and you shall be to me a kingdom of priests, and a holy nation.’ These are the words which you shall speak to the…
For Yahweh’s portion is his people. Jacob is the lot of his inheritance.
Blessed is the nation whose God is Yahweh, the people whom he has chosen for his own inheritance.
Remember your congregation, which you purchased of old, which you have redeemed to be the tribe of your inheritance…
For Yah has chosen Jacob for himself, Israel for his own possession.
But you are a chosen race, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a people for God’s own possession, that you may proclaim…
The portion of Jacob is not like these; for he is the maker of all things; and Israel is the tribe of his inheritance…
Our Redeemer, Yahweh of Armies is his name, is the Holy One of Israel.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: The portion of Jacob is not like these, for he is the former of all things; including the tribe of his inheritance: Yahweh of Armies is his name.
translations.bsb: The Portion of Jacob is not like these, for He is the Maker of all things, and of the tribe of His inheritance— the LORD of Hosts is His name.
translations.kjv: The portion of Jacob is not like them; for he is the former of all things: and Israel is the rod of his inheritance: the LORD of hosts is his name.
translations.asv: The portion of Jacob is not like these; for he is the former of all things; and Israel is the tribe of his inheritance: Jehovah of hosts is his name.
